description: Split a larger issue into tasks for the planner, builders and reviewer, with no file in two tasks.

- each task has a goal and a success criterion that can fail,
- each task lists its files, and no file appears in two tasks,
- the last task is "integrate, run bash scripts/verify.sh, request a review".
